title: Concept: Python requirement declared with no version constraint
description: requirements.txt declares a requirement line with no version specifier, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The installer takes whatever the index serves at build time, so a release published after review installs without a manifest change.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: The installer takes whatever the index serves at build time, so a release published after review installs without a manifest change.
